visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair appears in a medium close-up, wearing a voluminous, bright pink faux fur coat that she pulls up towards her chin. She is set against a clean, plain white studio background with bright, even lighting. Yellow and black text overlays are positioned in the center. (2) The scene cuts to a digital screen capture of an iPhone interface with a dark grey aesthetic. Various application icons like FaceTime, Calendar, and Photos are visible in a grid. The interface displays liquid-like UI elements and 3D depth effects as the screen navigates through settings. (3) The video shows a browser window with the 'Apple Developer Agreement' text. A blue selection dot taps on a 'Yes' radio button, followed by a finger-less interaction with a large 'Agree' button at the bottom of the screen. (4) A confirmation screen titled 'Thank you for completing your developer profile' appears. The layout then shifts to the internal settings of the iPhone, specifically showing the 'Software Update' section where 'iOS 26 Developer Beta' is selected, highlighted by a red graphical arrow. (5) The woman in the pink fur coat reappears briefly before the video concludes with another screen capture of the iOS App Library, showcasing icons organized in frosted glass-style folders against a monochromatic grey background.

(5) [Subtitle]: 如何更新到iOS 26 Beta. (6) [Slogan]: 關鍵字: Apple Developer. [Subtitle]: 現在只要用手機打開. (7) [Subtitle]: 蘋果開發者頁面. (8) [Subtitle]: 按照步驟註冊你的帳號. (9) [Subtitle]: 並取得資格後. (10) [Subtitle]: 就可以在iPhone上的設定. (11) [Subtitle]: 一般軟體更新項目內. (12) [Subtitle]: 看到Beta版的更新項目. (13) [Subtitle]: 此時就可以選擇是否要升級成. (14) [Subtitle]: iOS 26 Beta版了. (15) [Subtitle]: 但目前的測試版.
